【Lightweight and Durable】54CM aluminum frame.Eurobike road bike frame uses high-quality aluminum and professional Shimano components. Bikes are designed for people who like to ride or use it for daily commuting.

【New internal wiring frame】The simple and beautiful internal wiring design can effectively prevent the damage of rain and sunlight, reduce the probability of rust damage to the brake cable and the shifting cable, and increase the durability. It can also avoid riding scratch the cable tube in the middle, making riding safer.

【Brake System】The brake system consists of double caliper brakes, which is easier to operate than disc brakes and more aerodynamic. Precise speed control ensures the rider stops immediately in an emergency and is a good choice for men's road racing.

【700C Tires】700C adult road bicycle fits up to adult riders 5'5"-6'0". Dual aluminum rims and 700*25C road bike tires reduce drag while riding on gravel, city roads. Allows you to ride farther with the same energy.

【Assembly Instructions】Eurobike bikes are all 85% pre-assembled, there is an installation video on the product page, and it is easy to assemble within 20 minutes. Delivery box includes free assembly tools and pedals WITHOUT kickstand.
